content.text:
Yes, that's really common at 20 months. New 2am wakings often show up with a nap shift, teething, a big developmental leap, or a recent illness or schedule change.

For tonight, keep the wake-up boring. Go in quietly, keep the lights off, say a short calm line like "it's sleep time", and leave while they're still drowsy. Skip the feed, the play, and the screen, so 2am doesn't turn into something worth waking up for.

If they seem sick or in pain, check in with Health811 (call 811, any time). For an emergency, call 911.
